_readme: Shared cases for Copilot's update_todo markdown checklist. The Go worker parses it for the to-do sidebar and the browser parses it for the tool body, so both suites replay this corpus. Copilot's own tool schema describes the argument as 'a markdown checklist of TODO items showing completed and pending tasks'; only the two markers the markdown task-list syntax defines are read, and every other marker stays pending.

cases.name: reads both task-list markers
cases.checklist:
- [x] Read the code
- [ ] Write the test

cases.name: accepts every list bullet and leading whitespace
cases.checklist:
* [ ] Star item
+ [ ] Plus item
  	- [x] Indented item

cases.name: skips every line that is not a checklist item
cases.checklist:
# Plan

Some prose.
- Plain bullet
- [] Malformed
- [ ]
- [ ]   
- [x] Real item

cases.name: keeps the item text intact
cases.checklist:
- [ ] Run `task test` and check the [report](./out.html)
- [x] 한글 항목

cases.name: an empty checklist is an empty list
whitespace alone is an empty list
